deadlines.notes: Bristol says the final deadline for all international undergraduate applications is 30 June, but some courses fill up and may close on 13 January. Medicine, dentistry and veterinary courses: 15 October 2026.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Course pages: required if English is not your first language, unless you hold GCSE English Language grade C/4 or an alternative qualification listed in the profile (on the Profile E page the US options are AP Language and Composition or AP Literature and Composition at 3, ACT English 23 with 7 in Writing, or SAT Reading 33 and Writing 33). Profile E (lowest band, Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering) shown; Economics is Profile G (IELTS 6.5 overall with 7.0 in reading and listening).

english.notes: IELTS Academic, Profile E. Profile G (Economics): 7.0 in reading and listening, no score below 6.0.
Old 0-120 scale (tests taken up to 20 January 2026), Profile E. Profile G (Economics): 88 overall with R24 L22 S22 W22.
New 1-6 scale (tests taken from 21 January 2026), Profile E. Profile G (Economics): 4.5 overall with 5 in reading and listening and 4.5 in speaking and writing.
PTE Academic (test centre), Profile E. Profile G (Economics): 67 overall, 71 in reading and listening, 64 in other skills. The page notes PTE Academic Online was valid for 2023 entry only.

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 17th of 130 UK universities (B = ranks 16-40 on the national scale).
